edges.source_hint: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy entry on Principia Mathematica; general histories of mathematical logic.
edges.note: Fourth co-canonical work for subfield:mathematical-logic, joining Boole's Laws of Thought, Frege's Begriffsschrift, and Goedel's incompleteness paper (decision (90)). Flagged for QC to confirm this is a genuine additional watershed and not dilution, given the subfield already holds three.
edges.rationale: Principia Mathematica is as universally credited a watershed in mathematical logic as the field's other three co-canonical works (the logicist program, ramified type theory), consistent with decision (90)'s own framing of the subfield as having multiple founding texts.
edges.uncertainty: Genuine judgment call: whether a fourth co-canonical work for the same subfield is warranted breadth or approaching dilution is exactly the question W1 exists to bound, and I cannot resolve it myself without appearing to grade my own proposal -- flagged explicitly for QC.
